name: SQL injection against a patched, WAF-protected app
description: Baseline. The NIDS fires on a UNION SELECT payload sent to web01. shopfront 5.2.1 is not affected by CVE-2023-27013 and ModSecurity blocked the request with 403. The correct outcome is FAILED with no block; the source goes on the watch-list.
